correctness.rationale: For arbitrary characteristic-two k and m=2^h>=4, the explicit equation (1+z)=(r+r^{-1})r(r+1)^{m/2-2} ensures both right and left generator action differences lie in every two-sided ideal. This proves equality in both directions without relying on computational sampling. All formulas checked at small m with exact direct group multiplication and exhaustive m=4 F2 RREF enumeration; no extension of finite experimental evidence to infinite cases.

value.rationale: For every power-of-two group size and every characteristic-two field, a canonical ambient-space identity of two-sided ideal lattices gives a natural Hamming-isometric correspondence of all two-sided group codes. This is stronger than equal counts or abstract lattice isomorphism, and it distinguishes the two-sided vs one-sided code behavior of closely related but nonisomorphic modular group algebras.
